notes: kb/Work PB5251 landed. §1985:XIII.3.11.3 SR2: "Within a given print line, the printable items must be defined in ascending column number order such that each printable item defined occupies a unique sequence of contiguous character positions." ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportColumnArrangement walks each line's nominal placements (NominalPlacements) and refuses an out-of-order pair of absolute items and an overlapping pair (COBOL2745). Its exception for two items each subject to a different PRESENT WHEN clause is a 2002 rule: PresentWhenClausesOf counts a GROUP INDICATE clause as such a clause only from COBOL-2002 (§2002:13.16.26.3 GR1), and the 1985 language has no PRESENT WHEN clause, so at 85 no pair is excused. Witnesses: 1985-SR-XIII_3_11_3-2 and the two refusals of GROUP INDICATE pairs (out of order; overlapping), each COBOL2745 at 85; the 2002 acceptance is pb5251_group_indicate_items_out_of_column_order.

next.reason: 1985 requires printable items in a line in ascending column order, each occupying unique positions, with no exception. 2023 allows absolute items 'not in increasing numerical order' and overlapping items when each is 'subject to a different PRESENT WHEN clause' (§2023:13.18.14.3 SR7, SR8a); a multiple COLUMN clause keeps increasing order (§2023:13.18.14.3 SR10b); an overlap at print time sets EC-REPORT-COLUMN-OVERLAP with undefined results (§2023:13.18.14.4 GR4). A 1985 program (no PRESENT WHEN) is refused the same way; 2023 accepts sources 1985 refused. Looser.
